title: Insulin pump firmware update
context: Firmware manages basal rates, bolus delivery, and fails safe on watchdog resets. Interfaces via Bluetooth Low Energy with encrypted sessions.
output: Validation demonstrates encrypted firmware transfer, verifies bolus queue persistence across resets, and confirms watchdog-triggered safe shutdown logs events for audit.

title: Telemetry data aggregator
context: Python service collects device vitals, normalizes units, and stores in PostgreSQL with role-based access control.
output: Validation covers unit normalization algorithms, database migration integrity, and access-control enforcement across user roles and audit reporting.
